input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a samplesheet CSV file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It must contain at least a header row and the columns 'sample' and 'fastq_1'.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_mode.help_text: Sets Nextflow's `workflow.output.mode` configuration option, which specifies how output files should be moved to the final output directory, e.g. by copying or via symlink.

report_suffix.description: A suffix to add to the report filenames. Defaults to the current timestamp in `yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss` format.

gadi_options.title: Gadi options
gadi_options.description: Options specific to running on NCI's Gadi HPC.
gadi_options.help_text: These options are only for running the pipeline on NCI's Gadi HPC. They will not work with other executors.

gadi_account.description: The NCI project to use when submitting jobs to Gadi.
gadi_account.help_text: Sets the NCI project to use when submitting jobs. Set to your default project (`${PROJECT}`) if not supplied.

gadi_storage.description: The Gadi filesystems to mount for each job.
gadi_storage.help_text: Specifies which Gadi filesystesm to mount for each submitted job, e.g. `scratch/ab01+gdata/ab01`. Defaults to `/scratch/${PROJECT}`.

gadi_user.help_text: Sets the NCI project to use when submitting jobs. Defaults to your current username (`${USER}`).

singularity_cache_dir.description: The directory to use for your Singularity cache.
singularity_cache_dir.help_text: Sets the directory to use for the Singularity cache. Defaults to `/scratch/${PROJECT}/${USER}/.nextflow/singularity`.
